name: Micronesia (FSM)
summary_text: The Federated States of Micronesia demands real caution. No federal criminalisation (some states historically had provisions); US-associated; no LGR; no documented anti-trans pattern; very thin data.

sources.claim_summary: ILGA World Database jurisdiction page for Micronesia (FSM): documents the legal status of same-sex conduct and gender recognition.

sources.title: Human Dignity Trust
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Only the Human Dignity Trust homepage was retrievable at fetch time (no FSM-specific page); the Trust maps jurisdictions criminalising LGBT people. FSM does not criminalise same-sex conduct.
US State Department 2010 Human Rights Report for Micronesia (archived): general human-rights assessment - no laws criminalising homosexuality; limited LGBT-specific content.
US State Department 2015 Human Rights Report for Micronesia (archived): official assessment - no criminalisation; societal stigma exists but no reported discrimination or violence.
US State Department 2015 report for Micronesia, Section 6 (Women): the section covering societal attitudes including sexual orientation - no reports of discrimination against LGBT persons.
US State Department 2015 report for Micronesia, Section 4 (Trafficking): general human-rights context.
